title: PDS MPP: Project Plan Editor
shortDescription: Stage requested plan edits informed by authorized M365 context.
longDescription:
PDS MPP Plan Editor helps project managers, planners, and PMO analysts apply specific changes to Microsoft Project (.mpp) plans in Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams. Select a plan you can access and describe the requested change. The agent can use accessible OneDrive or SharePoint files, email, and Teams messages as planning context, then stage and validate supported edits to tasks, progress, dependencies, resources, and assignments. A clear, explicit edit request may authorize the agent to commit that change. Analysis or a draft-only request does not authorize a save. Not every Microsoft Project field or operation is supported.

For session-only output, the host's download app delivers the resulting MPP; this is not a cloud write-back. To save to OneDrive or SharePoint, you must explicitly request write-back, the destination and file must be resolved, you must have write permission, and the Teams host confirmation must be completed. A preview or successful validation alone does not prove that a file was saved; open the result to verify it.

An active PDS account and access to Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams are required to use this app. You also need permission to access the selected plan and any OneDrive or SharePoint files, email, or Teams messages used as context. Teams sign-in alone does not sign you in to PDS. Search is limited to content your account can access. Usage is subject to account limits. After your app access is enabled, your PDS account is automatically created and assigned to the Freemium plan when you first sign in through MCP. You can start directly in Microsoft 365 Copilot; no separate PDS web-portal visit or account sign-up is required. If you need to request access, visit https://projectdata.io/project-ai. The PDS portal is also available at https://my.projectdata.ai. Help Center: https://pdms.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/categories/40422614580893-ProjectData-AI. Contact Us: https://projectdata.io/contact-us or support@projectdata.io. Supported language: English.
conversationStarters: Review a project plan and prepare a specific requested edit.
Draft changes to tasks, dependencies, or resources in a selected plan.
Apply a requested edit to a Microsoft Project plan.
